title: Somewhere Quiet and Hopeful
tests: Whether the agent turns a vague mood into a coherent illustration without demanding unnecessary creative decisions from the user.

judge.summary: A soft, cohesive illustration of a warmly lit cottage beside a still pond conveys quiet and gentle hope, with no visible problems or lettering.

must_haves.item: The deliverable is an illustration rather than a photograph.
must_haves.why: Painterly washes, textured paper, and softly drawn forms clearly establish an illustration.

must_haves.item: The composition conveys quiet through visual restraint, stillness, or spaciousness rather than busy action.
must_haves.why: The still pond, empty landscape, broad sky, and solitary cottage create a restrained, peaceful composition.

must_haves.item: A visible cue such as gentle light, growth, or an opening conveys some hope rather than unrelieved gloom.
must_haves.why: Warm golden windows, a softly glowing horizon, and flowering meadow provide gentle hopeful cues.

must_haves.item: The scene and palette form a coherent mood rather than a collection of unrelated elements.
must_haves.why: Muted greens, blue-gray hills, and cream and peach light unify the cottage, pond, and meadow.
No visible words, lettering, or signatures appear.
